Troubleshooting · 16/50 · color

Look LUT baked into source

Failure signal

A look lut baked into source condition is reported or detected during color.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for color does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare neutral chart values and camera originals to detect irreversible look processing.

Corrective action

Return to the unprocessed source or document the baked look as a creative constraint.

Prevention

Add this verification to the color gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
